final: WITH g AS (SELECT f.orderslink AS orderslink, o.ordertune AS ordertune, AVG(f.rebtotal) AS avg_rebate, AVG((f.rebrate - f.feerate) / f.feerate) AS avg_rel_gap FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.ordertune), b AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rebate) AS baseline FROM g) SELECT g.orderslink, g.ordertune, g.avg_rebate, g.avg_rel_gap, g.avg_rebate - b.baseline AS excess_over_baseline FROM g, b WHERE g.avg_rebate > b.baseline ORDER BY excess_over_baseline DESC LIMIT 10
